title: The Twisted Harvest Case
story: In the quaint town of Millfield, an unexpected tragedy unfolded. Last seen, well-respected farmer, Elijah Blackwood, was huddled over a seemingly innocent harvest festival scene. Yet, his lifeless body was later discovered in the same location, with a peculiar symbol etched into the wooden floor. Against the backdrop of a somber autumn evening, four witnesses found themselves in the middle of the carnage.
crimeScene: The bustling center of Millfield's harvest festival, amidst a sea of enthusiastic revellers.
forensicClue: The symbol etched into the wooden floor; a mysterious spiral.
question: Who committed the heinous act, and how did they manage to escape unnoticed amidst the chaos of the festival?
options: Option A (Suspect 1: Cynthia, a quirky artist; reason: an obsession with ancient rituals)
Option B (Suspect 2: Gabriel, a disgruntled festival organizer; reason: motive to sabotage the event)
Option C (Suspect 3: Marcus, the town librarian; reason: knowledge of rare books and obscure rituals)
Option D (Suspect 4: Sarah, a young couple's counselor; reason: a cryptic note found near the body)
